title: Why Stabilis Solutions Shares Jumped Over 71%; Here Are 70 Biggest Movers From Yesterday
description:
Gainers

Stabilis Solutions, Inc.  (NASDAQ: SLNG) shares climbed 71.3% to close at $8.84 after the company announced it has received authorization from the U.S. Department of Energy to export domestically produced liquefied natural gas to all free trade and non-free trade countries.
ECMOHO Limited (NASDAQ: MOHO) surged 50.3% to close at $0.1744. ECMOHO announced that it has received delisting notice from the Nasdaq. The company said it has elected to not appeal Nasdaq Listing Qualifications Department's determination.
IDEX Biometrics ASA (NASDAQ: IDBA) gained 21.4% to close at $6.96. IDEX Biometrics and Sentry Enterprises will launch biometric smart card for digital authentication.
Kaixin Auto Holdings (NASDAQ: KXIN) gained 20.4% to settle at $0.7823.
Cepton, Inc. (NASDAQ: CPTN) rose 17.4% to close at $2.09 after the company announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to add Cepton lidar models into NVIDIA DRIVE Sim.
FREYR Battery (NYSE: FREY) climbed 17.1% to settle at $15.39. Morgan Stanley maintained FREYR Battery with an Overweight and raised the price target from $18 to $26.
QualTek Services Inc. (NASDAQ: QTEK) gained 15.3% to close at $1.28.
Semantix, Inc. (NASDAQ: STIX) jumped 14.8% to close at $2.95.
Evaxion Biotech A/S (NASDAQ: EVAX) rose 14.2% to close at $2.33 as the company reached an important milestone announcing that it had enrolled its first patient in the global phase 2b clinical trial of EVX-01, its personalized cancer therapy.
Air T, Inc. (NASDAQ: AIRT) gained 14.2% to settle at $22.17.
Winc, Inc. (NYSE: WBEV) jumped 12% to close at $1.03. Winc announced on September 19, Geoffrey Mcfarlane, CEO stepped down, effective immediately.
Fennec Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NASDAQ: FENC) gained 11.9% to close at $8.54. Fennec Pharmaceuticals announced the FDA approval of PEDMARK.
Bone Biologics Corporation (NASDAQ: BBLG) gained 11.4% to close at $1.17.
Twin Vee Powercats Co. (NASDAQ: VEEE) rose 10.4% to settle at $3.30.
Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. (NASDAQ: CDRO) gained 8.7% to close at $3.01.
Maravai LifeSciences Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVI) rose 8% to close at $25.09.
Celularity Inc. (NASDAQ: CELU) gained 7.9% to close at $2.61.
Starry Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: STRY) rose 7.7% to close at $1.95.
AnPac Bio-Medical Science Co., Ltd. (NASDAQ: ANPC) rose 7% to close at $0.1605.
SmartRent, Inc. (NASDAQ: SMRT) gained 6.7% to settle at $2.71.
Apollo Medical Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMEH) gained 6.6% to close at $41.71. William Blair initiated coverage on Apollo Medical with an Outperform rating.
